subject: pharmacology
title: Clarithromycin and Macrolide Pharmacology: 50S Ribosome, CYP3A4, Motilin and Typhoid

steps.tx: **Clarithromycin** methylates erythromycin into acid stability and twice daily grace, covering respiratory pathogens, atypicals, Helicobacter pylori regimens and Mycobacterium avium complex treatment and prophylaxis, with an active 14 hydroxy metabolite adding Haemophilus reach. It is the macrolide whose interaction empire (next step) prescribers must actually memorise, because its ribosomal pharmacology is clean and its hepatic pharmacology is anything but.
steps.say: Clarithromycin fixed erythromycin's acid problem and kept its interaction empire fully staffed.

points: H pylori triple and quadruple regimens

steps.tx: **CYP3A4 inhibition** is clarithromycin's second prescription hidden inside the first: it multiplies levels of statins (simvastatin rhabdomyolysis from the lipid lessons), colchicine (fatal in renal impairment), calcium channel blockers (hypotension in the elderly), tacrolimus, many anticoagulants and sedatives, while its own levels are gutted by inducers. Erythromycin shares the crime; azithromycin largely does not, which is the single most useful sentence in macrolide interaction practice.
steps.say: Clarithromycin and erythromycin strangle CYP3A4, azithromycin barely touches it; choose by the drug list.

nodes.label: Clarithromycin inhibits intestinal and hepatic CYP3A4
Statin, colchicine or blocker levels multiply

steps.tx: The **50S ribosome** exit tunnel unites macrolides, lincosamides (clindamycin), streptogramins and chloramphenicol and oxazolidinones nearby, a crowded binding neighbourhood explaining cross resistance (erm methylation) and why combinations among them add little. Bacteriostatic labels bend: macrolides kill Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus at achievable concentrations in many models, another reminder from principles that static and cidal are contexts, not essences.
steps.say: Five families crowd one ribosomal tunnel; methylation evicts them together.

steps.tx: **Motilin agonist** activity is erythromycin's second identity: at sub antimicrobial doses (40 to 250 mg) it storms gastric and intestinal motility, used briefly for gastroparesis and feeding intolerance before tachyphylaxis retires it within weeks, and explaining the cramps and diarrhoea that dose limit its antibiotic life. Clarithromycin and azithromycin inherit weaker versions. Motilin agonism is also why erythromycin empties stomachs before emergency endoscopy in upper gastrointestinal bleeding protocols.
steps.say: Erythromycin shakes the gut by motilin design; prokinetic today, tachyphylaxis tomorrow.

points: Low dose erythromycin before feeds or endoscopy

right.title: Antimicrobial cost

steps.tx: **Typhoid fever** (enteric fever) assembles this module's rivals into a resistance driven algorithm: fluoroquinolones fell to decreased susceptibility across South Asia, ceftriaxone and azithromycin divide current therapy by severity and XDR (extensively drug resistant) geography, chloramphenicol and cotrimoxazole return only where susceptibility is proven, and carbapenems rescue XDR sepsis. Azithromycin's intracellular concentration suits Salmonella's intracellular life, a mechanism to indication sentence examinations reward.
steps.say: Typhoid therapy is resistance geography: ceftriaxone or azithromycin by severity, chloramphenicol only on proof.

left.title: Modern typhoid choices
points: Uncomplicated: azithromycin oral where XDR threatens
XDR sepsis: carbapenem by specialist direction

right.title: Historical agents on proof only
points: Relapse and carriage follow up completes therapy

steps.tx: **Macrolide QT and** hearing complete the safety grammar: QT prolongation stacks with the antiarrhythmic, antipsychotic and quinolone shelves (torsades arithmetic by list review), reversible sensorineural hearing loss and tinnitus accompany high dose or prolonged erythromycin and azithromycin especially in renal impairment and the elderly, and cholestatic hepatitis (erythromycin estolate historically) and pancreatitis decorate the rare ledger.
steps.say: QT lists and hearing questions belong in every prolonged macrolide review; both effects usually reverse.

nodes.label: Stop, ECG and electrolytes, substitute class

steps.tx: **Ketolides** (telithromycin) tried to out engineer erm resistance and were fenced by hepatotoxicity and visual and myasthenia effects into near extinction, while fidaxomicin, a macrocycle cousin acting on RNA polymerase rather than ribosomes, owns C difficile next lesson. The family's lesson is iterative: each successor fixes one predecessor flaw (acid, gut, interactions, resistance) and invoices a new one, which is why the founder's ribosome still anchors the teaching.
steps.say: Every macrolide successor fixes one flaw and invoices another; the ribosome outlasts them all.

left.title: Successor engineering
points: Azithromycin: tissue life, minimal CYP effects

steps.tx: **Pertussis and diphtheria** niches close the macrolide map: azithromycin is first line for Bordetella pertussis (catarrhal stage benefit, transmission reduction at all stages, infant pyloric stenosis weighed under six weeks), erythromycin historically for diphtheria adjunct and Campylobacter, and clarithromycin in MAC and H pylori combinations. Incubation windows, post exposure prophylaxis for vulnerable contacts and notification duties ride with these prescriptions in public health practice.
steps.say: Pertussis belongs to azithromycin at any stage for transmission, youngest infants weighed individually.
